# DeepGym Contributor Assignment Agreement

Version 2.0

Thank you for your interest in contributing to DeepGym ("We" or "Us").

This contributor agreement ("Agreement") documents the rights granted by contributors to
Us. You accept this Agreement by signing it electronically through the CLA bot that
comments on Your pull request. Your signature through the bot has the same effect as a
handwritten signature. This is a legally binding document, so please read it carefully
before agreeing to it. The Agreement covers every software project, repository and other
work managed by Us under the DeepGym name.

## 1. Definitions

"You" means the individual who Submits a Contribution to Us.

"Contribution" means any work of authorship that is Submitted by You to Us in which You
own or assert ownership of the Copyright, including source code, documentation, tests,
data, environments, tasks, graders, configuration, images and other material. If You do
not own the Copyright in the entire work of authorship, You must name the parts You do not
own, their owner, their license and where they came from in the pull request or message
that Submits them.

"Copyright" means all rights protecting works of authorship owned or controlled by You,
including copyright, moral and neighboring rights, database rights and any other
intellectual property rights in the work other than patents, as appropriate, for the full
term of their existence including any extensions by You.

"Material" means the work of authorship which is made available by Us to third parties.
When this Agreement covers more than one software project, the Material means the work of
authorship to which the Contribution was Submitted. After You Submit the Contribution, it
may be included in the Material.

"Submit" means any form of electronic, verbal, or written communication sent to Us or our
representatives, including but not limited to pull requests, patches, issues, comments,
electronic mailing lists, source code control systems, and issue tracking systems that are
managed by, or on behalf of, Us for the purpose of discussing and improving the Material,
but excluding communication that is conspicuously marked or otherwise designated in
writing by You as "Not a Contribution."

"Submission Date" means the date on which You Submit a Contribution to Us.

"Effective Date" means the date You first Submitted a Contribution to Us, whether before
or after You sign this Agreement.

"Media" means any portion of a Contribution which is not software.
